tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, labels and help text on color-surface, color-surface-subtle and color-bg-page (4.9:1 on the page canvas).

tokens.name: color-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Counts in the segmented filter and the "/ budget" part of a took cell. 3.2:1 on color-surface, below 4.5:1: kept exact from the source; use it only for supplementary figures.

tokens.name: color-text-faint
tokens.usage: Axis range in table heads and the grey dot of an off status. 2.3:1 on color-surface, below 4.5:1: kept exact from the source; never for text that carries meaning.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on color-accent fills (primary button, selected stepper step) and on color-accent-disabled.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, links, link-buttons, focus outline, active tab underline, selected choice border. 5.2:1 on color-surface.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills.

tokens.name: color-accent-bg
tokens.usage: Hover fill of outline buttons and selected choice-card fill; text on it is color-text.

tokens.name: color-accent-disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled button instead of opacity. color-on-accent on it is 1.9:1: kept exact from the source, the control is disabled.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Dot and bar for on or healthy.

tokens.usage: Text on color-success-bg and color-surface: on pills, valid tags, additions in diffs.

tokens.name: color-success-bg

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Dot and solid bar for over budget. 2.2:1 on color-surface: the dot is paired with words.

tokens.name: color-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of warn tags and ratio pills.

tokens.usage: Light bar out to p95 for an over-budget route.

tokens.name: color-error-border
tokens.usage: Light bar out to p95 for a route at 3x budget or more.

tokens.usage: Confirm button of a destructive prompt until the user types DELETE; strikethrough colour of removed text.
